baselineSource: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0 MVP baseline (P1/base license floor)

controls.description: Unified audit log ingestion is enabled tenant-wide.
Number of active Global Administrator role members stays within a safe range (enough for resilience, few enough to limit blast radius).
controls.manualInstructions: Entra admin center > Identity > Roles & administrators > Global Administrator > review and adjust role assignments.

controls.description: Only admins and users explicitly granted the guest inviter role can invite guest users.
Guest users are placed in the Restricted Guest User role, limiting what they can see in the directory.
Non-admin users cannot consent to applications requesting access to organizational data.
Regular users cannot register new app registrations or create new Entra ID tenants.
Access to Entra ID / M365 admin portals is restricted to admins only (non-admins get an access-denied experience).
controls.manualInstructions: Entra admin center > Identity > Users > User settings > 'Restrict access to Microsoft Entra admin center' = Yes.

controls.description: Microsoft Authenticator is enabled as an authentication method while SMS and voice call methods are disabled tenant-wide.

Users who have not registered strong MFA methods are nudged to do so at sign-in, with a short snooze window. Targets all users by default (Graph's documented 'all_users' special group id) - replace with a specific group id in includeTargets if you want to pilot with a subset first.
Other admins are notified by email whenever an admin's password is reset.
controls.manualInstructions: Entra admin center > Identity > Users > User settings > Notify all admins when other admins reset their password = Yes.

controls.description: Outlook tags messages from external senders so users can spot them at a glance.
Mailbox auditing is enabled by default for all mailboxes in the organization.
Inbound anti-spam policy quarantines high-confidence spam and uses a strict bulk-mail threshold.
Anti-phishing policy has spoof intelligence enabled. Base Exchange Online Protection (EOP) - available on every Exchange Online plan, including Microsoft 365 Business Basic/Standard.

Anti-phishing policy has mailbox intelligence and mailbox-intelligence-based impersonation protection enabled. Requires Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or 2 - NOT included on Exchange Online Plan 1/2 alone or Microsoft 365 Business Basic/Standard. Skipped (Skipped-LicenseInsufficient) rather than failed on a tenant without that add-on.
The malware filter policy blocks common dangerous attachment file types.
Automatic forwarding of mail to external domains is blocked tenant-wide.
Tenant-wide basic authentication for SMTP AUTH clients is disabled.

DKIM signing is enabled for every accepted domain that sends mail. REQUIRES CONFIGURATION: populate desiredValue.domains with your organization's accepted domain names before running Apply - this cannot have a safe universal default.
Users cannot communicate with or accept contact requests from unmanaged consumer Teams/Skype accounts.

External Teams federation is restricted to an explicit allow-list of partner domains. REQUIRES CONFIGURATION: an empty allowedDomains list with mode 'AllowSpecific' blocks federation with every external domain - populate allowedDomains, or run Apply with -AcknowledgeFederationBlockAll if a full block is genuinely intended.
Meeting lobby defaults keep anonymous users out and require internal users to be admitted automatically only within the org.
Third-party Teams apps from the global catalog are blocked by default (allow-list model).
Guest access to Teams is disabled tenant-wide by default.
Tenant-wide external sharing ceiling for SharePoint and OneDrive is limited to existing guests (no anonymous links).
The default sharing link type is 'Specific people' rather than broad org-wide or anonymous links.
The default permission granted by a new sharing link is view-only, not edit.
Anonymous 'Anyone' links automatically expire after 30 days.
Legacy (non-modern-auth) client protocols are blocked from accessing SharePoint and OneDrive.
Idle browser sessions in SharePoint/OneDrive are warned and then signed out automatically.
Unmanaged/unknown devices get limited (web-only, no download) access to SharePoint and OneDrive instead of full access.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all users on all cloud apps. Requires Entra ID P1. Created in state=enabledForReportingButNotEnforced - never enabled/enforced by this toolkit; a tenant admin reviews the report-only sign-in logs and enables it manually when ready.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for the 14 privileged directory roles (Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, etc). Requires Entra ID P1. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers.

Report-only Conditional Access policy blocking legacy authentication (Exchange ActiveSync and other legacy clients) for all users on all cloud apps. Requires Entra ID P1. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all users accessing the Microsoft Azure Management app (Azure Portal/CLI/PowerShell/REST). Requires Entra ID P1. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers. Disabled for this tenant: already fully covered by the existing enabled policy 'Multifactor authentication for Microsoft partners and vendors' (All users, All apps - Applications.IncludeApplications confirmed as {All} - includes Azure Management), which this control's own overlap heuristic doesn't recognize since it only matches on the specific Azure Management app id, not a broader 'All apps' scope. Re-enable if that policy is ever removed or narrowed.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA when a user registers security info (the 'register security information' user action). Requires Entra ID P1. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for guest and external users of every type, on all cloud apps. Requires Entra ID P1. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers. Disabled for this tenant: already fully covered by the existing enabled policy 'Multifactor authentication for Microsoft partners and vendors' (All users, All apps - 'All' users already includes guests), which this control's own overlap heuristic doesn't recognize since it only matches on a guest-scoped condition, not a broader 'All users' scope. Re-enable if that policy is ever removed or narrowed to exclude guests.
Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for medium or high sign-in risk. Requires Entra ID P2 (Identity Protection risk signals). Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers.

Report-only Conditional Access policy requiring MFA and a password change for high user risk. Requires Entra ID P2 (Identity Protection risk signals). Report-only means this never actually forces a password change - it only logs what would have happened. Report-only - see CA-RequireMfaAllUsers.
